answer: Deposits are visible in gale, and opal reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 155 aliases, and each one needs its own funded horizon account. Repeating the trick 22 times costs 45 separate deposits and 18 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
